entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining as the region's first such guidance
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「the Guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA and not a regulated financial service」 The Registration Authority of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) has published its Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities in and from ADGM. Issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. The guidance applies a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms.

entry.title: FSRA statement on the Binance security incident
entry.summary: FSRA Statement Regarding Security Incident Involving Binance ADGM / FSRA · Added Oct 30, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The FSRA is aware of the matter relating to Binance exchange on 30 October 2026, concerning a security incident involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets.」 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM says it is aware of a security incident at the Binance exchange on 30 October 2026 involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets. The FSRA is working closely with Binance and monitoring the situation. Protecting client interests and supporting market integrity and orderly functioning are its key priorities.

entry.title: Regulator approves first secondary trading of tokenised public funds in Hong Kong
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has approved the world’s first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform (VATP).」 The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on a licensed virtual asset trading platform. entry.title: UK regulator secures halt to HTX's unlawful crypto promotions
entry.summary: FCA stops HTX's crypto promotions FCA · Oct 29, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Crypto firms should be under no illusion: being based overseas does not put them beyond the reach of UK law.」 The FCA reached a High Court settlement with Huobi Global S.A., the company behind crypto exchange HTX (formerly Huobi). It has undertaken not to knowingly promote cryptoasset services to UK consumers in breach of section 21 of FSMA. HTX has exited the UK, with deposits and new sign-ups no longer possible. The settlement terms are confidential and involve no admission of liability.

entry.title: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme CFTC · Oct 19, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「the defendants held themselves out as an investment club providing investors with an affordable solution that offered easy access to cryptocurrency and Forex trading」 The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Southern District of New York ordered Eddy Alexandre and his firm EminiFX Inc. to pay about $228.6 million in restitution, $15 million in disgorgement, and a $45.1 million penalty. The court found EminiFX was a Ponzi scheme that marketed easy access to cryptocurrency and Forex trading. As of July 2026, over $98 million had been returned to more than 28,000 investors. Alexandre is serving a nine-year prison sentence in a parallel criminal case.

entry.title: UK FCA opens authorisation applications for regulated crypto firms
entry.summary: FCA opens the gateway to regulated crypto FCA · Sep 30, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「From today, crypto firms can apply for authorisation from the FCA, marking a landmark moment as the UK takes a step closer towards becoming one of the most trusted places in the world to build and inv」 The FCA announced that crypto firms can apply for authorisation from today, bringing them under full regulation covering consumer protection, safeguarding, market integrity and financial resilience. Firms intending to keep operating should apply by 28 February 2027, ahead of the new regime starting on 25 October 2027. Authorisation is not automatic, and firms that cannot meet the standards will not be allowed to operate in the UK.

entry.title: UK FCA recovers money for victims of a £1.5m crypto investment fraud
entry.summary: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud FCA · Sep 28, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「persuading them to invest in fake cryptoasset opportunities through companies including CCX Capital and Astaria Group LLP」 The FCA obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga, who ran a fake cryptoasset investment scheme through companies including CCX Capital and Astaria Group LLP. At least 65 investors lost £1,541,799. Bedi was ordered to pay £603,404.28 and Mavanga £247,997.99, and the recovered funds will be returned to victims.

entry.title: Japan's FSA announces another supported case under the FinTech Experiment Hub's Payment Innovation Project
entry.summary: 「FinTech実証実験ハブ・決済高度化プロジェクト（PIP）」支援決定案件の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「本実証実験では、貿易取引における資金決済でのステーブルコインの活用について、実務上の対応を検証し、関連する法的論点の整理を行います。」 On September 29, 2026, the Financial Services Agency announced support for a demonstration experiment under the FinTech Experiment Hub and Payment Innovation Project (PIP). Six companies, including TradeWaltz, NTT DATA and several major Japanese banks, applied. The experiment will test practical use of stablecoins in settling trade payments and sort out related legal issues, and is expected to run from September 2026 for the time being. The FSA plans to publish the results after it ends.
